iterations.theme: Molitveni dio: molitve zaštite i posvete, Krunica Božjeg milosrđa, litanije i Gospina krunica

sections.subtitle: Svetkovina Svih Svetih počinje pozivom na radost
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora i čita redak iz evanđelja dana
sections.content:
Epizoda broj 125 medija Ora et Labora, naslovljena **„Milosrđe Božje – Svetkovina Svih Svetih!“**, počinje kratkim pozdravom. Voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** obraća se „dragim gledateljima i slušateljima medija Ora et Labora“. Odmah zatim donosi redak iz evanđelja dana: **„Radujte se i kličite, velika je plaća vaša na nebesima.“**

Te riječi iz Isusova govora o blaženstvima određuju ton cijele emisije. Govore o radosti i nadi u nebesku nagradu, što pristaje svetkovini na kojoj Crkva slavi sve one koji su tu nagradu već primili.

Nakon pozdrava slijedi znak križa: „U ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga. Amen.“ Time počinje opsežan molitveni dio koji traje gotovo trideset sedam minuta. Obuhvaća:

- molitve zaštite i oslobođenja,
- molitve posvete,
- Krunicu Božjeg milosrđa,
- Litanije Božjem milosrđu,
- Gospinu krunicu sa slavnim otajstvima,
- završnu molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“.

Voditelj sve molitve izgovara sam. Velik dio tekstova napisan je u množini („nas“, „naše obitelji“), pa molitva od početka uključuje cijelu zajednicu onih koji je prate.
sections.subtitle_en: The Solemnity of All Saints begins with a call to joy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar greets the viewers and listeners of the media outlet Ora et Labora and reads a verse from the gospel of the day
sections.content_en:
Episode number 125 of the media outlet Ora et Labora, entitled **„Divine Mercy – Solemnity of All Saints!“**, begins with a brief greeting. Host **Vladimir Grebenar** addresses the „dear viewers and listeners of the media outlet Ora et Labora“. Immediately thereafter he presents a verse from the gospel of the day: **„Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven.“**

Those words from Jesus' discourse on the Beatitudes set the tone for the entire program. They speak of joy and hope in the heavenly reward, which suits the solemnity on which the Church celebrates all those who have already received that reward.

After the greeting follows the sign of the cross: „In the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.“ With that begins an extensive prayer section that lasts nearly thirty-seven minutes. It encompasses:

- prayers of protection and deliverance,
- prayers of consecration,
- the Chaplet of Divine Mercy,
- the Litany of Divine Mercy,
- the Rosary of Our Lady with the glorious mysteries,
- the concluding prayer „Hail, Holy Queen“.

The host recites all the prayers alone. A large part of the texts is written in the plural („us“, „our families“), so from the beginning the prayer includes the entire community of those following along.

sections.subtitle: Molitva oslobođenja: vezivanje zlih sila i poziv nebeskim zaštitnicima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu kojom u ime Isusovo vezuje zle sile i obitelji stavlja pod zaštitu Kristove krvi
sections.content:
Prva molitva u emisiji je molitva za oslobođenje i zaštitu. Voditelj počinje riječima: **„U ime Isusovo uzimam vlast i vežem sve zle sile i snage“**. Zatim nabraja gdje se te sile nalaze:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi,
- u vatri.

Nakon toga molitva se okreće slavljenju Boga: „Ti si Gospodin nad svim svemirom; dajem ti slavu u ime tvoga stvorenja.“ U ime Isusovo vezuju se „sve demonske sile koje su došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“. Svi koji mole stavljaju se pod zaštitu Kristove **„dragocjene krvi koja je prolivena za nas na križu“**.

U drugom dijelu molitva traži nebesku zaštitu. Od Marije, „naše majke“, moli se zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji, uz zaziv: **„Zaogrni nas svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj.“** Zatim se zazivaju sveti Mihovil i anđeli čuvari da „brane nas i naše obitelji u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.

Vrhunac molitve je zapovijed: „U ime Isusovo zapovijedam svim silama i snagama zla da odstupe istog časa od nas, od naših domova i naše zemlje.“ Molitva završava zahvalom Isusu „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.

### Molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu

Odmah zatim, u 00:01:27, slijedi molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu. Arkanđela se moli da „brani nas u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da bude „zaklon“. Naziva ga se **„vojvodom vojske nebeske“** i moli da „Sotonu i druge duhove zlobne koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša, božanskom krepošću i jakošću u pakao strovali“.
sections.subtitle_en: Prayer of deliverance: binding evil powers and invoking heavenly protectors
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host recites a prayer by which in the name of Jesus he binds evil powers and places families under the protection of the blood of Christ
sections.content_en:
The first prayer in the program is a prayer for deliverance and protection. The host begins with the words: **„In the name of Jesus I take authority and bind all evil powers and forces“**. Then he lists where those powers are found:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature,
- in fire.

After that, the prayer turns to praising God: „You are the Lord over all the universe; I give you glory in the name of your creation.“ In the name of Jesus, „all demonic forces that have come against us and our families“ are bound. All who pray place themselves under the protection of Christ's **„precious blood that was shed for us on the cross“**.

In the second part, the prayer seeks heavenly protection. From Mary, „our mother“, intercession is implored before the Sacred Heart of Jesus for all families, with the invocation: **„Clothe us with your mantle of love, so that the enemy may be terrified.“** Then Saint Michael and the guardian angels are invoked to „defend us and our families in the battle against all evil that roams the world“.

The climax of the prayer is the command: „In the name of Jesus I command all powers and forces of evil to depart immediately from us, from our homes, and from our land.“ The prayer ends with thanksgiving to Jesus „because you are a faithful God and feel with us“.

### Prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel

Immediately thereafter, at 00:01:27, follows the prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel. The Archangel is asked to „defend us in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil“ and to be a „safeguard“. He is called the **„prince of the heavenly host“** and asked to, „by the divine power and strength, cast into hell Satan and all other evil spirits who prowl through the world seeking the ruin of souls“.

sections.subtitle: Jedinstvo s Isusom i posvete dvama Srcima
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Nakon molitava zaštite emisija prelazi na molitve predanja i jedinstva. U 00:01:47 voditelj izgovara molitvu jedinstva s Isusom: **„Moj ljupki Isuse, neka naše noge zajedno hode, neka naše ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu, neka naša srca kucaju zajedno“**. Molitva redom traži sklad duše, misli, sluha i pogleda: „neka naše uši zajedno slušaju tišinu, neka naši pogledi duboko prodru jedan u drugi“. Završava molbom da „naše usne zajedno mole da zadobijemo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca“.

### Posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu

U 00:02:21 slijedi posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu. Mariju se zaziva kao „majku i kraljicu“ i njezinu Srcu predaje se **„čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“**. Posveta traži da Marija raspolaže svime što molitelju pripada, „sada i u vječnosti“. Svrha je trostruka: „na hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, za posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta“.

U završnom dijelu posvete moli se pomoć da se živi „dostojno moga krsnog posvećenja“ i da se „neopozivo pripada svome Otkupitelju“. Molitelj traži i da, poput Marije, sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga, kako bi se u njemu i u svemu vršila volja Božja.

### Molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu

U 00:03:06 slijedi molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu, koje se naziva **„izvorom svakoga dobra“**. Molitva povezuje klanjanje, vjeru, ufanje, ljubav i kajanje za grijehe. Molitelj Isusu daruje „ovo moje siromašno srce“ i moli da ga učini „poniznim, strpljivim, čistim“. Traži zaštitu u opasnostima, utjehu u nevoljama i žalostima, zdravlje tijela i blagoslov rada. Molitva završava molbom za „milost svete smrti“.
sections.subtitle_en: Union with Jesus and consecrations to the Two Hearts
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host recites the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
After the prayers of protection, the broadcast moves on to prayers of surrender and union. At 00:01:47 the host recites a prayer of union with Jesus: **„My lovely Jesus, may our feet journey together, may our hands be gathered in unity, may our hearts beat together“**. The prayer in turn asks for harmony of soul, thoughts, hearing, and sight: „may our ears listen to the silence together, may our gazes penetrate deeply into one another“. It concludes with a plea that „our lips pray together to obtain mercy from the eternal Father“.

### Consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary

At 00:02:21 follows the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary. Mary is invoked as „mother and queen“ and to her Heart is surrendered **„one's entire being, one's thoughts, words, and deeds“**. The consecration asks that Mary dispose of everything that belongs to the person praying, „now and in eternity“. The purpose is threefold: „for the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, for the sanctification of the Church, and the salvation of the whole world“.

In the concluding part of the consecration, help is sought to live „worthily of my baptismal consecration“ and to „belong irrevocably to my Redeemer“. The person praying also asks, like Mary, to listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit, so that in him and in everything the will of God may be accomplished.

### Prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus

At 00:03:06 follows a prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus, which is called the **„source of every good“**. The prayer connects adoration, faith, hope, love, and contrition for sins. The person praying offers Jesus „this poor heart of mine“ and asks Him to make it „humble, patient, pure“. He asks for protection in dangers, consolation in afflictions and sorrows, health of body, and blessing of work. The prayer ends with a plea for the „grace of a holy death“.

sections.subtitle: Krunica Božjeg milosrđa: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci…“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv…“ na početku desetice Krunice Božjeg milosrđa
sections.content:
U 00:03:38 voditelj najavljuje: **„Slijedi krunica Božjega milosrđa.“** To je središnja molitva epizode, kojoj i naslov emisije daje ime „Milosrđe Božje“.

Krunica počinje uvodnim molitvama:

- **Oče naš**,
- **Zdravo Marijo**,
- **Vjerovanje**, isповijest vjere u Boga Oca Stvoritelja, u Isusa Krista „mučenog pod Poncijem Pilatom“, raspetog, umrlog, pokopanog i uskrslog, te u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Svaka od pet desetica počinje istom molitvom prikazanja: **„Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga Sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“**

Nakon toga deset puta se ponavlja zaziv: **„Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“** Taj zaziv obilježava gotovo osam minuta emisije, od 00:05:23 do 00:11:30. Ponavljanje stvara ritam u kojem se jedna rečenica pretvara u ustrajnu molbu za milosrđe, i to ne samo za one koji mole nego za cijeli svijet.

Zaziv počiva na Kristovoj muci i sadrži dvije misli: grijeh je stvaran i zahtijeva zadovoljštinu, a Božje milosrđe dostupno je svakome po Sinovoj žrtvi.
sections.subtitle_en: Chaplet of Divine Mercy: „For the sake of His sorrowful Passion…“
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host recites the prayer „Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood…“ at the beginning of a decade of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy
sections.content_en:
At 00:03:38 the host announces: **„Next is the Chaplet of Divine Mercy.“** That is the central prayer of the episode, which also gives the program its title „Divine Mercy“.

The Chaplet begins with opening prayers:

- **Our Father**,
- **Hail Mary**,
- **The Creed**, profession of faith in God the Father Creator, in Jesus Christ „suffered under Pontius Pilate“, crucified, died, buried, and risen, and in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

Each of the five decades begins with the same offering prayer: **„Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world.“**

After that, the invocation is repeated ten times: **„For the sake of His sorrowful Passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“** That invocation marks nearly eight minutes of the broadcast, from 00:05:23 to 00:11:30. The repetition creates a rhythm in which a single sentence turns into a persistent plea for mercy, not only for those praying but for the whole world.

The invocation rests upon Christ's passion and contains two thoughts: sin is real and requires atonement, and God's mercy is available to everyone through the Son's sacrifice.

sections.subtitle: Od „Svetog Bože“ do litanija: trideset zaziva Božjem milosrđu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli Litanije Božjem milosrđu s ponavljanim odgovorom „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Krunica Božjeg milosrđa završava u 00:11:33 trostrukim zazivom: **„Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelome svijetu.“**

Zatim slijede zazivi uzdanja:

- „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova, kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“
- „Marijo, majko milosrđa, moli za nas.“
- tri puta ponovljeno **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“**

### Litanije Božjem milosrđu

U 00:12:21 počinju Litanije Božjem milosrđu. Nakon uobičajenog uvoda („Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se…“) i zaziva Presvetom Trojstvu slijedi dugi niz zaziva. Svaki počinje riječima „Milosrđe Božje“, a završava odgovorom **„uzdam se u tebe“**.

Zazivi prate povijest spasenja od stvaranja do vječnosti. Milosrđe se opisuje kao:

- „neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izraz njegove najveće moći“,
- ono koje se objavilo „u stvaranju nebeskih duhova“ i koje „nas iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- ono koje „nas zaštićuje od zasluženih kazna“ i „oslobađa od bijede grijeha“,
- ono koje se „izlijeva iz rana Kristovih“ i „izvire iz Presvetoga Srca“,
- ono koje je „dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa“,
- ono vidljivo u ustanovljenju Crkve i sakramenata, „neograničeno u sakramentu krštenja i pokore“ i „neizmjerno u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva“,
- „vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima“, „ufanje onih koji očajavaju“ i „mir umirućih“,
- ono koje „olakšava patnje dušama u čistilištu“ i koje je „neizmjerna radost sviju svetih“,
- „neiscrpivi izvor čudesa“.

### Završna molitva

Litanije završavaju retkom: **„Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“** Slijedi zaključna molitva vječnom Bogu, „čije je milosrđe neistraživo i čije blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“. U njoj se moli da Bog umnoži milosrđe u vjernicima, „da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni“. Vjernici se trebaju predati „s velikim pouzdanjem“ Božjoj svetoj volji, „koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje“. Molitva se zaključuje po Isusu Kristu, **„kralju milosrđa“**.
sections.subtitle_en: From „Holy God“ to the litany: thirty invocations to Divine Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the Litany of Divine Mercy with the repeated response „I trust in you“
sections.content_en:
The Chaplet of Divine Mercy ends at 00:11:33 with the threefold invocation: **„Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world.“**

Then follow invocations of trust:

- „O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fount of mercy for us, I trust in you.“
- „Mary, Mother of Mercy, pray for us.“
- repeated three times **„Jesus, I trust in you.“**

### Litany of Divine Mercy

At 00:12:21 the Litany of Divine Mercy begins. After the usual introduction („Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy…“) and invocations to the Most Holy Trinity follows a long series of invocations. Each begins with the words „Divine Mercy“, and ends with the response **„I trust in you“**.

The invocations trace salvation history from creation to eternity. Mercy is described as:

- „incomprehensible mystery of the Most Holy Trinity“ and „expression of His greatest power“,
- that which was revealed „in the creation of heavenly spirits“ and which „called us from nothingness into life“,
- that which „protects us from deserved punishments“ and „frees us from the misery of sin“,
- that which „flows forth from the wounds of Christ“ and „gushes from the Sacred Heart“,
- that which „gave the Blessed Virgin as Mother of Mercy“,
- that visible in the establishment of the Church and sacraments, „unlimited in the sacrament of baptism and penance“ and „immense in the sacrament of the altar and priesthood“,
- „source for the sick and suffering“, „hope of those who despair“, and „peace of the dying“,
- that which „relieves the sufferings of souls in purgatory“ and which is „immense joy of all saints“,
- „inexhaustible source of miracles“.

### Concluding prayer

The litany concludes with the verse: **„God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and full of goodness. Therefore forever I will sing the mercies of the Lord.“** Follows the concluding prayer to the eternal God, „whose mercy is unsearchable and whose treasure of compassion is inexhaustible“. In it, the prayer asks that God increase mercy in believers, „that in difficult moments we might not despair nor become discouraged“. Believers should submit „with great confidence“ to God's holy will, „which is love and compassion itself“. The prayer is concluded through Jesus Christ, **„King of Mercy“**.

sections.subtitle: Gospina krunica: uskrsnuće i uzašašće
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje prvo slavno otajstvo Gospine krunice, Isusovo uskrsnuće
sections.content:
U 00:16:40 voditelj najavljuje: **„Slijedi Gospina krunica.“** Moli se pet **slavnih otajstava**, koja prate Kristovu i Marijinu proslavu.

### Prvo otajstvo: „koji je od mrtvih uskrsnuo“

Prvo otajstvo posvećeno je Isusovu uskrsnuću. Kao i svaka desetica, počinje molitvom **Oče naš**, nakon koje slijedi deset **Zdravo Marija**. Ime Isusovo u svakoj Zdravo Mariji povezuje se s otajstvom koje se razmatra. Desetica završava molitvom **Slava Ocu** i zazivom:

> „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe. Očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja. Dovedi u raj sve duše, osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe.“

Taj završni zaziv povezuje krunicu s temom epizode. I ovdje je u središtu milosrđe, i to prema dušama kojima je ono „najpotrebnije“.

### Drugo otajstvo: „koji je na nebo uzašao“

U 00:20:37 počinje drugo slavno otajstvo, Isusovo uzašašće na nebo. Desetica ima isti oblik: Oče naš, deset Zdravo Marija, Slava Ocu i ponovno molba da Isus oprosti grijehe, očuva od paklenoga ognja i dovede u raj sve duše. Voditelj desetice moli bez komentara, pa ponavljanje i tišina između molitava daju prostor za osobno razmatranje.
sections.subtitle_en: The Rosary of Our Lady: resurrection and ascension
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the first glorious mystery of the Rosary of Our Lady, Jesus' resurrection
sections.content_en:
At 00:16:40 the host announces: **„Next is the Rosary of Our Lady.“** Five **glorious mysteries** are prayed, which follow Christ's and Mary's glorification.

### First mystery: „who rose from the dead“

The first mystery is dedicated to Jesus' resurrection. Like every decade, it begins with the **Our Father** prayer, followed by ten **Hail Marys**. The name of Jesus in each Hail Mary is linked to the mystery being contemplated. The decade ends with the **Glory Be to the Father** prayer and the invocation:

> „O my Jesus, forgive us our sins. Save us from the fires of hell. Lead all souls to heaven, especially those who are most in need of your mercy.“

That closing invocation links the rosary to the theme of the episode. Here too, mercy is at the center, specifically toward the souls that are „most in need“ of it.

### Second mystery: „who ascended into heaven“

At 00:20:37 the second glorious mystery begins, Jesus' ascension into heaven. The decade has the same form: Our Father, ten Hail Marys, Glory Be to the Father, and again the plea that Jesus forgive sins, save from the fires of hell, and lead all souls to heaven. The host prays the decades without commentary, so repetition and silence between prayers provide space for personal contemplation.

sections.subtitle: Duhovi, uznesenje i okrunjenje: vrhunac slavnih otajstava
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje peto slavno otajstvo, okrunjenje Blažene Djevice Marije
sections.content:
Druga polovica krunice prelazi s Kristove proslave na dar Duha Svetoga i Marijinu proslavu.

### Treće otajstvo: „koji je Duha Svetoga poslao“

U 00:24:37 voditelj najavljuje treće otajstvo, silazak Duha Svetoga. Nakon molitve Oče naš slijedi deset Zdravo Marija, zatim Slava Ocu i zaziv „O moj Isuse“. Molitva završava molbom za duše „kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“.

### Četvrto otajstvo: „koji je tebe, Djevice, na nebo uznio“

U 00:28:30 počinje četvrto otajstvo, posvećeno uznesenju Blažene Djevice Marije na nebo. Desetica se moli istim redom i s istim zaključnim molbama za oproštenje, zaštitu od paklenoga ognja i spasenje svih duša.

### Peto otajstvo: „koji je tebe, Djevice, na nebu okrunio“

Zadnje otajstvo, najavljeno u 00:32:27, razmatra okrunjenje Marije na nebu. Time se zatvara slijed koji počinje Kristovim uskrsnućem, a završava proslavom njegove Majke.

Razmatranje Marijina okrunjenja pristaje Svetkovini Svih Svetih. Prvo stvorenje okrunjeno u nebeskoj slavi pokazuje cilj kojemu teže svi koji se nadaju „velikoj plaći na nebesima“ iz evanđelja dana.
sections.subtitle_en: Pentecost, the Assumption, and the Coronation: climax of the glorious mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the fifth glorious mystery, the Coronation of the Blessed Virgin Mary
sections.content_en:
The second half of the rosary shifts from Christ's glorification to the gift of the Holy Spirit and Mary's glorification.

### Third mystery: „who sent the Holy Spirit“

At 00:24:37 the host announces the third mystery, the descent of the Holy Spirit. After the Our Father prayer follow ten Hail Marys, then Glory Be to the Father and the invocation „O my Jesus“. The prayer ends with a plea for souls „who are most in need of your mercy“.

### Fourth mystery: „who assumed you, Virgin, into heaven“

At 00:28:30 begins the fourth mystery, dedicated to the assumption of the Blessed Virgin Mary into heaven. The decade is prayed in the same order and with the same concluding petitions for forgiveness, protection from the fire of hell, and salvation of all souls.

### Fifth mystery: „who crowned you, Virgin, in heaven“

The last mystery, announced at 00:32:27, contemplates the coronation of Mary in heaven. This closes the sequence that begins with Christ's resurrection and ends with the glorification of his Mother.

The contemplation of Mary's coronation suits the Solemnity of All Saints. The first creature crowned in heavenly glory shows the goal toward which all those strive who hope for the „great reward in heaven“ from the gospel of the day.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo Kraljice“: molitva prognanih sinova Evinih
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli završnu marijansku molitvu „Zdravo Kraljice“
sections.content:
Molitveni dio završava u 00:36:26 molitvom **„Zdravo Kraljice“**. Mariju se u njoj pozdravlja kao „majku milosrđa, život, slast i ufanje naše“. Naziv „majka milosrđa“ veže ovu molitvu uz glavnu temu emisije, kao i ranije zazive Mariji u Krunici Božjeg milosrđa.

Molitva opisuje ljudski život kao progonstvo: **„K tebi vapijemo, prognani sinovi Evini, k tebi uzdišemo tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini.“** Mariju se zatim moli kao „zagovornicu“ da svrne „one svoje milostive oči na nas“ i da „poslije ovoga progona“ pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Molitva završava trostrukim zazivom: **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo.“** Zemaljski život prikazan je kao suzna dolina, a nada je usmjerena prema susretu s Kristom u vječnosti, isto kao u evanđelju dana koje obećava nagradu na nebesima.

Posljednjim „Amen“ zatvara se gotovo trideset sedam minuta neprekinute molitve. Voditelj odmah najavljuje sljedeći dio emisije: **„Slijedi tumačenje svete riječi“**.
sections.subtitle_en: „Hail, Holy Queen“: prayer of the banished children of Eve
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host recites the concluding Marian prayer „Hail, Holy Queen“
sections.content_en:
The prayer section ends at 00:36:26 with the prayer **„Hail, Holy Queen“**. In it Mary is greeted as „Mother of Mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope“. The title „Mother of Mercy“ links this prayer to the main theme of the program, as well as to earlier invocations to Mary in the Chaplet of Divine Mercy.

The prayer describes human life as an exile: **„To you do we cry, poor banished children of Eve; to you do we send up our sighs, mourning and weeping in this valley of tears.“** Mary is then implored as „advocate“ to turn „your eyes of mercy toward us“ and „after this exile“ show Jesus, „the blessed fruit of your womb“.

The prayer concludes with the threefold invocation: **„O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary.“** Earthly life is depicted as a valley of tears, and hope is directed toward an encounter with Christ in eternity, just as in the gospel of the day which promises a reward in heaven.

With the final „Amen“, nearly thirty-seven minutes of uninterrupted prayer comes to an end. The host immediately announces the next part of the program: **„Next is the interpretation of the holy word“**.

iterations.theme_en: Prayer section: prayers of protection and consecration, Chaplet of Divine Mercy, litany, and the Rosary of Our Lady

sections.subtitle: Patmoska vizija: opečaćeni i nebrojeno mnoštvo u bijelim haljinama
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Vladimir Grebenar započinje čitanje iz Knjige Otkrivenja nakon završene molitve Zdravo Kraljice
sections.content:
Nakon krunice Božjega milosrđa, Gospine krunice i molitve *Zdravo Kraljice*, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** prelazi na središnji dio emisije, tumačenje svete riječi za svetkovinu Svih svetih. Prvo čitanje uzeto je iz Knjige Otkrivenja i donosi jednu od najsnažnijih slika posljednje knjige Biblije.

U čitanju apostol Ivan opisuje kako vidi „drugog jednog anđela“ koji uzlazi od istoka sunčeva s pečatom Boga živoga. Taj anđeo iza glasa doviknuje četvorici anđela kojima je dano nauditi zemlji i moru: „Ne udite ni zemlji ni moru ni drveću dok ne opečatimo sluge Boga našega na čelima.“ Zatim se navodi broj opečaćenih, **144.000 iz svih plemena sinova Izraelovih**.

Vizija se potom širi. Ivan vidi veliko mnoštvo koje nitko ne može izbrojiti, iz svakog naroda, plemena, puka i jezika. Stoje pred prijestoljem i pred Jaganjcem, odjeveni u bijele haljine, s palmama u rukama, i kliču: „Spasenje Bogu našemu koji sjedi na prijestolju i Jaganjcu.“ Svi anđeli oko prijestolja, starješine i četiri bića padaju ničice i klanjaju se Bogu, pjevajući o blagoslovu, slavi, mudrosti, zahvalnici, časti, moći i snazi Bogu u vijeke vjekova.

Čitanje završava dijalogom koji daje ključ cijelog odlomka. Jedan od starješina pita tko su ti odjeveni u bijelo i odakle dolaze. Ivan odgovara: „Gospodine moj, ti to znaš.“ Starješina tada otkriva: „Oni dođoše iz nevolje velike i oprali su haljine svoje i ubijelili ih u krvi Jaganjčevoj.“
sections.subtitle_en: Patmos vision: the sealed and a countless multitude in white robes
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Vladimir Grebenar begins reading from the Book of Revelation after concluding the Hail, Holy Queen prayer
sections.content_en:
After the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the Rosary of Our Lady, and the prayer *Hail, Holy Queen*, host **Vladimir Grebenar** moves to the central part of the broadcast, the interpretation of the holy word for the solemnity of All Saints. The first reading is taken from the Book of Revelation and brings one of the most powerful images of the final book of the Bible.

In the reading, the apostle John describes how he sees „another angel“ ascending from the rising of the sun with the seal of the living God. That angel calls out with a loud voice to the four angels who were given power to harm the earth and the sea: „Do not harm the earth or the sea or the trees until we have sealed the servants of our God on their foreheads.“ Then the number of those sealed is given, **144,000 from all the tribes of the children of Israel**.

The vision then widens. John sees a great multitude that no one could count, from every nation, tribe, people, and tongue. They stand before the throne and before the Lamb, clothed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands, and cry out: „Salvation belongs to our God who sits upon the throne, and to the Lamb.“ All the angels around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures fall on their faces and worship God, singing of blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might to God forever and ever.

The reading concludes with a dialogue that provides the key to the entire passage. One of the elders asks who these clothed in white are and where they come from. John replies: „My lord, you know.“ The elder then reveals: „These are the ones who have come out of the great tribulation; they have washed their robes and made them white in the blood of the Lamb.“

sections.subtitle: Anđeo s istoka: sud koji vjernima donosi oslobođenje, a grešnima osudu
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar objašnjava da anđeo koji dolazi s istoka simbolizira Božji sud
sections.content:
Tumačenje Vladimir Grebenar započinje kontekstom. Riječ je o viđenju koje je sveti Ivan apostol imao na otoku **Patmosu**, kada je od Isusa dobio zadaću zapisati posljednju knjigu koja će ući u kanon, posljednju knjigu Biblije.

Zatim se zadržava na jednom detalju: anđeo dolazi **s istoka sunčeva**. „S istoka tko dolazi? Sud“, kaže voditelj. Da je riječ o sudu, prema njegovu tumačenju potvrđuje i to što anđeo nosi pečat Boga živoga.

Taj sud, objašnjava Grebenar, ima dvostruko lice:

- **za vjerne** on znači oslobođenje od tereta, zbog čega anđeo pečati upravo njih;
- **za grešne** isti taj sud postaje osuda.

Voditelj to opisuje kao **„veliki preokret“**. Oni koji su prošli kroz veliku nevolju i ubijelili haljine u krvi Jaganjčevoj nosili su, kako kaže, velike pritiske, terete, umor i „žegu dana“ te podnosili tegobe za kraljevstvo Božje. Kada dođe sud s istoka, Bog se proslavi, njih oslobodi, a osudi one koji su činili zlo i nisu se obratili.

Iz toga izvodi poruku za slušatelje: postoji vrijeme dano za obraćenje, a nakon njega „nema više“, to je vrijeme prošlo. „Ovo je opomena za nas“, zaključuje.
sections.subtitle_en: The angel from the east: judgment bringing deliverance to the faithful and condemnation to sinners
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar explains that the angel coming from the east symbolizes God's judgment
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar begins the interpretation with context. It concerns a vision that Saint John the Apostle had on the island of **Patmos**, when he received the task from Jesus to write down the final book that would enter the canon, the final book of the Bible.

Then he lingers on one detail: the angel comes **from the rising of the sun**. „From the east, who comes? Judgment“, says the host. That it is a matter of judgment, according to his interpretation, is also confirmed by the fact that the angel bears the seal of the living God.

That judgment, Grebenar explains, has a two-fold face:

- **for the faithful** it means deliverance from burdens, which is why the angel seals precisely them;
- **for sinners** that same judgment becomes condemnation.

The host describes this as a **„great turning point“**. Those who passed through the great tribulation and made their robes white in the blood of the Lamb bore, as he says, great pressures, burdens, fatigue, and the „heat of the day“, and endured hardships for the kingdom of God. When judgment comes from the east, God is glorified, delivers them, and condemns those who did evil and did not convert.

From this he draws a message for the listeners: there is a time given for conversion, and after it „there is no more“, that time has passed. „This is a warning for us“, he concludes.

sections.subtitle: Četiri anđela na četiri strane svijeta i Sotona koji „rešeta“ Crkvu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori kako đavao ne može ništa učiniti dok mu Bog Otac ne da vlast
sections.content:
Sljedeći dio tumačenja posvećen je četvorici anđela kojima se obraća anđeo s pečatom Boga živoga. Vladimir Grebenar objašnjava da oni stoje na četiri strane svijeta, **istoku, zapadu, sjeveru i jugu**, te da svaka od tih strana ima svoje značenje.

Prenoseći sliku u svakodnevni život, voditelj kaže da ti anđeli na neki način drže ravnotežu, odnosno da drže stvari **pod Božjom kontrolom**. Iz toga izvodi jedno od ključnih teoloških polazišta svoga tumačenja: „Đavao ne može činiti ništa dok mu Bog Otac ne da vlast.“ Prema njegovim riječima, đavao ne može zagospodariti svijetom ni na određeno vrijeme ako mu Bog Otac to ne dopusti.

Kao biblijsku potvrdu navodi Isusove riječi upućene Petru: „Sotona je dobio vlast da vas prorešeta kao pšenicu.“ Grebenar tumači da Sotona može dobiti vlast da napadne i udari Crkvu, ali sa svrhom **pročišćenja**. Oni koji nisu Kristovi time otpadaju, a oni koji jesu Kristovi izbjeljuju svoje haljine u krvi Jaganjčevoj, „u muci velikoj“. Time zatvara krug s prvim čitanjem: velika nevolja iz Otkrivenja za njega je upravo to rešetanje kroz koje vjernici prolaze.
sections.subtitle_en: Four angels at the four corners of the earth and Satan „sifting“ the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host speaks about how the devil cannot do anything until God the Father gives him authority
sections.content_en:
The next part of the interpretation is dedicated to the four angels addressed by the angel with the seal of the living God. Vladimir Grebenar explains that they stand at the four corners of the earth, **east, west, north, and south**, and that each of those directions has its meaning.

Translating the image into everyday life, the host says that those angels in some way maintain balance, that is, they keep things **under God's control**. From this he draws one of the key theological starting points of his interpretation: „The devil can do nothing until God the Father gives him authority.“ According to his words, the devil cannot take control of the world even for a specific time if God the Father does not permit it to him.

As biblical confirmation he cites Jesus' words addressed to Peter: „Satan has obtained permission to sift you like wheat.“ Grebenar interprets that Satan can receive authority to attack and strike the Church, but for the purpose of **purification**. Those who are not Christ's thereby fall away, and those who are Christ's whiten their robes in the blood of the Lamb, „in great suffering“. He thus closes the circle with the first reading: the great tribulation from Revelation is for him precisely this sifting through which believers pass.

sections.subtitle: Viđenje nakon mise: četiri anđela prije nego što je poznavao čitanje
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar pripovijeda kako je u molitvi nakon svete mise vidio četiri anđela
sections.content:
Tumačenje zatim dobiva osobnu notu. Vladimir Grebenar priznaje da mu je ovo čitanje **„vrlo znakovito“** i objašnjava zašto. Emisiju, kaže, snima 31. listopada, a toga je jutra, prije nego što je pripremio tekst za sutrašnju svetkovinu, bio na svetoj misi.

Nakon što je primio tijelo Kristovo, ostao je u molitvi i nakon mise, uzeo si vremena i ušao „malo dublje u molitvu“. Tada je, prema vlastitom svjedočanstvu, imao iskustvo koje ga je iznenadilo: „Znate što sam vidio? Vidio sam **četiri anđela**. Nisam znao da je to današnje čitanje.“

Na tom mjestu stane i najavi da je vidio još nešto. Prije nego što to otkrije, prelazi na psalam za ovu svetkovinu.
sections.subtitle_en: A vision after Mass: four angels before he knew the reading
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar recounts how in prayer after Holy Mass he saw four angels
sections.content_en:
The interpretation then takes on a personal note. Vladimir Grebenar admits that this reading is **„very meaningful“** to him and explains why. He says he is recording the program on October 31, and that morning, before preparing the text for tomorrow's solemnity, he was at Holy Mass.

After receiving the body of Christ, he remained in prayer after Mass as well, took some time, and went „a little deeper into prayer“. Then, according to his own testimony, he had an experience that surprised him: „You know what I saw? I saw **four angels**. I didn't know that was today's reading.“

At that point he pauses and announces that he saw something else. Before revealing it, he moves on to the psalm for this solemnity.

sections.subtitle: „Gospodnja je zemlja i sve na njoj“: tko će uzići na goru Gospodnju
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj čita psalam o čistom srcu i nedužnim rukama
sections.content:
Psalam koji Vladimir Grebenar čita naglašava Božje vlasništvo nad svim stvorenim: „Gospodnja je zemlja i sve na njoj, svijet i svi koji na njemu žive. On ga na morima utemelji i na rijekama učvrsti.“

Zatim slijede retorička pitanja: „Tko će uzići na goru Gospodnju? Tko će stajati na svetom mjestu njegovu?“ Odgovor psalma glasi da je to **onaj u koga su ruke nedužne i srce čisto**, čija se duša ne predaje ispraznosti. Takav prima blagoslov od Gospodina i nagradu od Boga, spasitelja svoga. Psalam završava riječima: „Takav je naraštaj onih koji traže njega, koji traže lice Boga Jakovljeva.“

U kontekstu svetkovine Svih svetih psalam ocrtava upravo onu skupinu o kojoj govori Otkrivenje, ljude čista srca koji traže Božje lice.
sections.subtitle_en: „The earth is the Lord's and all that is in it“: who shall ascend the hill of the Lord
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host reads a psalm about a clean heart and innocent hands
sections.content_en:
The psalm that Vladimir Grebenar reads emphasizes God's ownership over all creation: „The earth is the Lord's and all that is in it, the world and all who live in it. For he founded it upon the seas and established it upon the rivers.“

Then follow rhetorical questions: „Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord? Who shall stand in his holy place?“ The psalm's answer is that it is **the one whose hands are innocent and whose heart is pure**, whose soul does not surrender to vanity. Such a one receives a blessing from the Lord and a reward from God, his savior. The psalm concludes with the words: „Such is the generation of those who seek him, who seek the face of the God of Jacob.“

In the context of the solemnity of All Saints, the psalm outlines precisely that group spoken of in Revelation, people of pure heart who seek God's face.

sections.subtitle: Anđeo koji je „pustio nešto iz ruke“ i nemiri koji se šire Europom
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar opisuje viđenje anđela koji iz ruke pušta nešto što pokreće događaje u svijetu
sections.subtitle_en: The angel who „released something from his hand“ and unrest spreading across Europe
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar describes a vision of an angel releasing something from his hand that sets events in motion in the world

sections.subtitle: Gospine poruke bez odjeka i poziv hrvatskom narodu na „Božji ustanak“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva hrvatski narod na Božji ustanak kroz post, molitvu i pokoru
sections.content:
Kao jedini način na koji se nemiri mogu spriječiti Vladimir Grebenar navodi ono na što poziva Gospa. U posljednjoj poruci, podsjeća, Gospa je pozvala da se **pojača molitva**.

Voditelj ne skriva razočaranje: „Žalostan sam što se Gospine poruke odbacuju.“ Poruke se, kaže, objavljuju po društvenim mrežama, ali ih „nitko ne doživljava“. Vrlo malo ljudi posti i moli na pravi način, a narod se premalo poziva na ustrajnost u molitvi i postu. „Jako, jako slabo, braćo i sestre, za zlo koje je u svijetu“, ocjenjuje.

Prema njegovoj procjeni, prosječna duhovnost u zapadnoj Europi i zapadnom svijetu preslaba je da bi se oduprla Sotoninoj moći. Za to su, kaže, potrebni **jaki postovi, ustrajne molitve i činjenje za Gospodina**.

Potom iznosi i težu ocjenu: zlo se u svijetu, smatra, više ni ne može spriječiti, jer je Sotona „zauzeo pozicije za veliku bitku i pripada mu što mu pripada“. Ipak, vidi iznimku. Zlo se, prema njegovim riječima, može spriječiti tamo gdje živi hrvatski narod i gdje ima vjere. Zato upućuje izravan poziv:

> Hrvatski narod mora se podići na ustanak, ali Božju bitku, Božji ustanak: post, molitva, pokora i činjenje za Gospodina.
sections.subtitle_en: Our Lady's messages without resonance and a call to the Croatian people for a „God's uprising“
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host calls the Croatian people to God's uprising through fasting, prayer, and penance
sections.content_en:
As the only way in which the unrest can be prevented, Vladimir Grebenar mentions what Our Lady calls for. In the latest message, he recalls, Our Lady called for prayer to be **intensified**.

The host does not hide his disappointment: „I am sorrowful that Our Lady's messages are being rejected.“ The messages, he says, are published across social networks, but „no one pays attention to them“. Very few people fast and pray the right way, and people are too seldom called to perseverance in prayer and fasting. „Very, very poor, brothers and sisters, for the evil that is in the world“, he assesses.

According to his assessment, average spirituality in Western Europe and the Western world is too weak to resist Satan's power. For that, he says, **strong fasts, persistent prayers, and doing for the Lord** are needed.

Then he presents an even harsher assessment: evil in the world, he believes, can no longer even be prevented, because Satan has „taken positions for the great battle and what belongs to him belongs to him“. Yet he sees an exception. Evil can, according to his words, be prevented where the Croatian people live and where there is faith. Therefore he issues a direct call:

> The Croatian people must rise up in an uprising, but God's battle, God's uprising: fasting, prayer, penance, and doing for the Lord.

sections.subtitle: „Djeca se Božja zovemo i jesmo“: uzbuđenje pred neizvjesnom vječnošću
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar s radošću govori o vječnosti koju je Bog pripremio
sections.content:
Drugo čitanje uzeto je iz **Prve Ivanove poslanice**: „Predragi, gledajte koliku nam je ljubav darovao Otac: djeca se Božja zovemo i jesmo. A zato nas svijet ne poznaje što ne poznaje njega.“ Poslanica nastavlja da se još ne očitova što ćemo biti, ali kada se očituje, bit ćemo mu slični, jer ćemo ga gledati kao što jest. Tko god ima tu nadu, čisti se kao što je on čist.

Vladimir Grebenar u tome vidi **obećanje da će vjernici biti Bogu slični** i da ih čeka budućnost, vječnost „kakvu ne možemo zamisliti“. Opisuje osobni doživljaj te neizvjesnosti: osjeća uzbuđenje i izazov, jer nitko na zemlji ne zna što je Bog pripremio. Podsjeća da Sveto pismo govori kako je Bog onima koji ustraju do spasenja pripremio „što oko nije vidjelo, što uho nije čulo“.

„Silno se radujem da se to dogodi“, kaže voditelj. Evanđelje je radosna vijest, a tko se može radovati Božjoj riječi, prema njegovim riječima, na dobrom je putu, jer je „već sad zakoračio u vječnost“.
sections.subtitle_en: „We are called children of God, and so we are“: excitement before uncertain eternity
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar speaks with joy about eternity prepared by God
sections.content_en:
The second reading is taken from the **First Epistle of John**: „Beloved, see what love the Father has bestowed on us, that we may be called the children of God; and so we are. The reason the world does not know us is that it did not know him.“ The Epistle continues that it has not yet been revealed what we shall be, but when it is revealed, we shall be like him, for we shall see him as he is. Everyone who has this hope purifies himself, just as he is pure.

Vladimir Grebenar sees in this **a promise that believers will be like God** and that a future, an eternity awaits them „such as we cannot imagine“. He describes a personal experience of that uncertainty: he feels excitement and challenge, because no one on earth knows what God has prepared. He reminds that Sacred Scripture speaks of how God has prepared for those who persevere until salvation „what no eye has seen, what no ear has heard“.

„I rejoice immensely that this will happen“, says the host. The gospel is good news, and whoever can rejoice in God's word, according to his words, is on the right path, because he has „already now stepped into eternity“.

sections.subtitle: Blaženstva s gore i Isus koji je govorio bez mikrofona
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj uspoređuje Isusovo propovijedanje na gori sa svojim nastupima na promocijama s mikrofonom i bez njega
sections.content:
Evanđelje svetkovine donosi Isusova **blaženstva**. Ugledavši mnoštvo, Isus se uspinje na goru, sjeda i počinje poučavati učenike:

- Blago siromasima duhom, njihovo je kraljevstvo nebesko.
- Blago ožalošćenima, oni će se utješiti.
- Blago krotkima, oni će baštiniti zemlju.
- Blago gladnima i žednima pravednosti, oni će se nasititi.
- Blago milosrdnima, oni će zadobiti milosrđe.
- Blago čistima srcem, oni će Boga gledati.
- Blago mirotvorcima, oni će se sinovima Božjim zvati.
- Blago progonjenima zbog pravednosti, njihovo je kraljevstvo nebesko.
- Blago vama kad vas zbog mene pogrde i prognaju i sve zlo slažu protiv vas.

Odlomak završava riječima kojima je i otvorena emisija: „Radujte se i kličite, velika je plaća vaša na nebesima.“

Vladimir Grebenar u tumačenju polazi od naizgled sporednog detalja: Isus je na gori govorio **bez mikrofona i zvučnika**. Uspoređuje to sa svojim iskustvom s promocija na kojima trenutačno nastupa. S mikrofonom ga svi lijepo čuju i ne mora vikati, a Isus je, kaže, morao vikati.

Iz vlastitog iskustva zaključuje da je poruka izgovorena bez mikrofona snažnija i nosi veće pomazanje, „zato što je autentično“. S mikrofonom se može govoriti „iz glave, iz racija“ i čitati unaprijed napisan govor. Bez mikrofona napisani govor nije moguće čitati, pa se, želi li se održati dobar govor, mora govoriti iz srca. Voditelj pritom pojašnjava da to ne znači da ne govori iz srca kada koristi mikrofon, ali bez njega, kaže, „sigurno“ govori iz srca.
sections.subtitle_en: The Beatitudes from the mount and Jesus who spoke without a microphone
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host compares Jesus' preaching on the mount with his own appearances at book presentations with and without a microphone
sections.content_en:
The gospel of the solemnity presents Jesus' **Beatitudes**. Seeing the multitudes, Jesus goes up on a mountain, sits down, and begins to teach his disciples:

- Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
- Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.
- Blessed are the meek, for they shall inherit the earth.
- Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.
- Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.
- Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.
- Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called sons of God.
- Blessed are those who are persecuted for the sake of righteousness, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.
- Blessed are you when they revile and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on my account.

The passage concludes with the words with which the broadcast was opened: „Rejoice and be glad, for your reward is great in heaven.“

In his interpretation Vladimir Grebenar starts from a seemingly secondary detail: Jesus on the mountain spoke **without a microphone and loudspeakers**. He compares this with his own experience from book presentations where he currently performs. With a microphone everyone hears him nicely and he does not have to shout, whereas Jesus, he says, had to shout.

From his own experience he concludes that a message spoken without a microphone is stronger and carries greater anointing, „because it is authentic“. With a microphone one can speak „from the head, from reason“ and read a pre-written speech. Without a microphone it is not possible to read a written speech, so, if one wants to give a good speech, one must speak from the heart. The host clarifies that this does not mean he does not speak from the heart when using a microphone, but without it, he says, he „certainly“ speaks from the heart.

sections.subtitle: Blaženstva kao put spasenja i poziv na osobno razmatranje
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj poziva slušatelje da u molitvi razmatraju blaženstva
sections.content:
Vraćajući se sadržaju evanđelja, Vladimir Grebenar ističe da Isus blaženstvo izriče **onima koji se spašavaju**: koji postižu spasenje, kojima se otvaraju vrata vječnosti, koji su daleko od propasti i koji ostavljaju prošlost iza sebe te se okreću budućnosti.

Umjesto da blaženstva redom tumači, voditelj slušateljima prepušta osobni rad: Gospodin je blaženstva redom nabrojao, a poziv je na svakome da uđe u molitvu i razmatra ono što piše. Izražava uvjerenje da će Gospodin svakome koji to učini „dati riječ u srce“, osobito na dan tako velike svetkovine.
sections.subtitle_en: The Beatitudes as the path of salvation and a call to personal contemplation
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host invites listeners to contemplate the Beatitudes in prayer
sections.content_en:
Returning to the content of the gospel, Vladimir Grebenar emphasizes that Jesus pronounces blessedness upon **those who are being saved**: who achieve salvation, to whom the doors of eternity are opened, who are far from destruction, and who leave the past behind them and turn toward the future.

Instead of interpreting the Beatitudes one by one, the host leaves personal work to the listeners: the Lord listed the Beatitudes in order, and the invitation is for everyone to enter into prayer and contemplate what is written. He expresses conviction that the Lord will „give a word into the heart“ of everyone who does so, especially on the day of such a great solemnity.

sections.subtitle: Nije Dušni dan, nego dan radosti: obiteljsko slavlje po uzoru na „slavu“
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj predlaže da katoličke obitelji slave Sve svete kao svoju svetkovinu
sections.content:
Vladimir Grebenar upozorava na raširenu zabunu. Ljudi na ovaj dan obično odlaze na groblje, ali to je, podsjeća, **Dušni dan**, koji se slavi sutradan. Svi sveti trebali bi biti dan **velike radosti**, s prekrasnim ručkom i obitelji na okupu.

Obitelji posvećene Bogu, prema njegovim riječima, trebale bi toga dana slaviti svoju svetkovinu. Kao usporedbu navodi pravoslavni običaj **slave**: obitelj izabere sveca zaštitnika i na njegov dan slavi. Na isti bi način, smatra voditelj, svi katolici trebali častiti i slaviti Sve svete, „jer to je, braćo i sestre, naša slava“.

Tumačenje zaključuje rečenicom: „Bog je proslavio svete zato što su oni proslavljali njega.“
sections.subtitle_en: Not All Souls' Day, but a day of joy: family celebration modeled on „slava“
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host proposes that Catholic families celebrate All Saints as their solemnity
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar warns of a widespread confusion. People usually visit cemeteries on this day, but that is, he recalls, **All Souls' Day**, which is celebrated the next day. All Saints should be a day of **great joy**, with a wonderful lunch and family gathered together.

Families consecrated to God, according to his words, should celebrate their solemnity on that day. As a comparison he cites the Orthodox custom of **slava**: a family chooses a patron saint and celebrates on his day. In the same way, the host believes, all Catholics should venerate and celebrate All Saints, „because that, brothers and sisters, is our slava“.

He concludes the interpretation with the sentence: „God glorified the saints because they glorified him.“

sections.subtitle: Turneja knjige „Isus Lider“ (treći dio): od Biograda do Nove Gradiške
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje raspored promocija knjige Isus Lider, treći dio
sections.content:
Nakon tumačenja Vladimir Grebenar poziva na promocije knjige **„Isus Lider“, treći dio**, s podnaslovom **„Kako spriječiti razorne demonske utjecaje?“**. Raspored predstavljanja je sljedeći:

- **ponedjeljak, 2. studenoga**: Biograd na Moru, hotel Ilirija, Tina Ujevića 7
- **utorak, 3. studenoga**: Solin, hotel President Solin
- **srijeda, 4. studenoga**: Imotski, Pučko otvoreno učilište Imotski
- **utorak, 10. studenoga**: Valpovo, vila Valpovo
- **srijeda, 11. studenoga**: Nova Gradiška, centar kompetencija Nova Gradiška

Voditelj napominje da je to zasad sve te da će naknadno objaviti raspored za idući dio turneje.
sections.subtitle_en: Book tour for „Isus Lider“ (part three): from Biograd to Nova Gradiška
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the schedule of book presentations for Isus Lider, part three
sections.content_en:
After the interpretation, Vladimir Grebenar invites to the book presentations of **„Isus Lider“, part three**, subtitled **„How to prevent destructive demonic influences?“**. The schedule of presentations is as follows:

- **Monday, November 2**: Biograd na Moru, Hotel Ilirija, Tina Ujevića 7
- **Tuesday, November 3**: Solin, Hotel President Solin
- **Wednesday, November 4**: Imotski, Public Open University Imotski
- **Tuesday, November 10**: Valpovo, Vila Valpovo
- **Wednesday, November 11**: Nova Gradiška, Competence Center Nova Gradiška

The host notes that this is all for now and that he will subsequently publish the schedule for the next part of the tour.

sections.subtitle: Završni blagoslov
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj zaključuje emisiju završnim blagoslovom
sections.content:
Emisiju za svetkovinu Svih svetih Vladimir Grebenar zatvara tradicionalnim blagoslovom: „Neka se sveta Mati sa svojim Sinom i svetim Josipom udostoji blagoslov svoj nam dati, u ime Oca i Sina i Duha Svetoga. Amen.“

Time završava epizoda u kojoj su se izmjenjivali molitva, tumačenje Otkrivenja, Prve Ivanove poslanice i blaženstava, osobno svjedočanstvo o viđenju četiriju anđela, poziv hrvatskom narodu na „Božji ustanak“ te obavijesti o radu inicijative Ora et Labora.
sections.subtitle_en: Concluding blessing
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host concludes the broadcast with a final blessing
sections.content_en:
Vladimir Grebenar closes the program for the solemnity of All Saints with a traditional blessing: „May the holy Mother with her Son and Saint Joseph deign to give us their blessing, in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.“

With that ends an episode in which prayer, interpretation of Revelation, the First Epistle of John, and the Beatitudes, personal testimony of a vision of four angels, a call to the Croatian people for a „God's uprising“, and notices about the work of the Ora et Labora initiative alternated.

iterations.theme_en: Interpretation of the holy word for the solemnity of All Saints, and announcements and notices of the Ora et Labora initiative
